hooks.name: TypeScript format + lint fix
hooks.description: On save of a frontend source file, apply eslint --fix then prettier --write over src. Idempotent; prettier runs last so formatting always wins and a second pass is a no-op.

action.command: cmd /c "cd frontend && node_modules\.bin\eslint.cmd --fix --quiet src & node_modules\.bin\prettier.cmd --write --log-level warn src"
